verdict.rationale: Viam documents several public APIs. The machine API lets you connect, get status and send commands, and the fleet management API lets you do in code what the web UI does. There is also an ML Training Client API and SDKs in Python, Go, C++, TypeScript and Flutter. The CLI can call any machine API method with JSON in and out, and there is a dedicated page on driving Viam from an AI agent. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 does not contradict this, since the docs describe a gRPC/WebRTC transport rather than REST. Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or published protos) was surfaced in the evidence, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven control.
